title: High Conformational Flexibility of the E2F1/DP1/DNA Complex.
authors: Saad, Dana; Paissoni, Cristina; Chaves-Sanjuan, Antonio; Nardini, Marco; Mantovani, Roberto; Gnesutta, Nerina; Camilloni, Carlo
one_liner_zh: 该文结合SAXS与分子动力学模拟，系统表征E2F1/DP1/DNA完整复合物的构象动态与柔性，揭示DP1对DNA结合稳定化的贡献，是TF-DNA复合物动态互作机制的高匹配研究。
abstract: The E2F1 transcription factor is a master regulator of cell-cycle progression whose uncontrolled activation contributes to tumor cells growth. E2F1 binds DNA as a heterodimer with DP partners, resulting in a multi-domain quaternary-structure complex composed of DNA binding domains, a coiled coil domain and a marked box domain separated by short linkers. Building on the 3D knowledge of the single domains of E2F and DPs, we characterized the structure and dynamics of the complete E2F1/DP1/DNA complex by a combination of small-angle X-ray scattering and molecular dynamics simulations. It shows an asymmetric contribution of the dynamics of the two proteins. Namely, the coiled-coil domain leans toward the DP1 side of the complex; the DP1 loop between alpha2 and alpha3 of the DBD partially populates a helical structure leaning far from the DNA and in the same direction of the coiled-coil domain; and the N-terminal disordered region of DP1, rich in basic residues, contributes to DNA binding stabilization. Intriguingly, tumor mutations in the flexible regions of the complex suggest that perturbation of protein dynamics could affect protein function in a context-dependent way. Our data suggest fundamental contributions of DP proteins in distinct aspects of E2F biology.
abstract_zh: E2F1转录因子是细胞周期进程的主要调控因子，其不受控制的激活有助于肿瘤细胞生长。E2F1与DP伙伴形成异二聚体结合DNA，产生由DNA结合域、卷曲螺旋域和标记盒域组成的多结构域四级结构复合物，这些结构域由短连接子分隔。基于E2F和DPs单个结构域的三维知识，我们通过小角X射线散射和分子动力学模拟相结合的方式，表征了完整E2F1/DP1/DNA复合物的结构和动力学。结果显示两种蛋白质的动力学贡献不对称。具体而言，卷曲螺旋域倾向于复合物的DP1侧；DP1的DBD中α2和α3之间的环部分填充了螺旋结构，远离DNA并朝向与卷曲螺旋域相同的方向；DP1的N端无序区域富含碱性残基，有助于DNA结合稳定化。有趣的是，复合物柔性区域中的肿瘤突变表明，蛋白质动力学的扰动可能以上下文依赖的方式影响蛋白质功能。我们的数据提示DP蛋白在E2F生物学的不同方面具有基础性贡献。
